name: correlation
meaning: Exactly one authoritative session/turn; initial child IDs absent
needed: Join terminal observation to one turn without a new identity

name: transport
source: Already-settled server trace transport vocabulary, server.py:359,524
meaning: http means REST; websocket means WS; never client-authored authority
needed: Separate REST/WS coverage required by A/B and later measurement

name: transport_trace_id
meaning: Associated server trace or None; distinct from P1 turn
needed: Join to existing trace without promoting it

name: outcome_type
meaning: Returned alternative; response variants are candidates only
needed: Distinguish stopped, operational candidate and conversational candidate without new stop vocabulary

name: stop_stage
meaning: Exact existing enum if stopped, otherwise None
needed: Locate the stopped stage; never invent completion-stage evidence

name: stop_reason
meaning: Exact existing enum if stopped, otherwise None

name: lane
meaning: Known terminal lane or None, never guessed from words/action

name: primary_action
meaning: Available actual action; two available sources must agree
needed: Unsupported/non-action behavior without copying targets or routing again

name: binding_metadata_digest
meaning: Supplied metadata digest, or None if no binding observation
needed: Identify the reviewed closed metadata basis; distinguish unobserved from empty binding

name: binding_action
meaning: Actual admitted binding action; None for valid empty pair or unavailable binding
needed: Verify which existing V1 row was observed without mapping anew

name: binding_capability
meaning: Verbatim deterministic capability; never from a proposal/schema
needed: Exact row evidence and detection of a third mapping by aggregation

name: binding_tool_name
trust: Observed expected identity; not model authority
meaning: Verbatim expected tool, never model-selected tool

name: binding_canonical_fingerprint
source: SHA256 of settled expected tool/version/canonical_arguments; FINGERPRINT.md
owner: Observation producer hashes settled values only
meaning: Deterministic digest of entire expected canonical binding, no target text retained
needed: Compare exact canonical binding against approved evidence references

name: proposal_count
source: Externally settled len of successful parser tuple[ToolProposal,...]
owner: Recorded adapter/P7 evaluator, when separately available
meaning: Exact nonnegative int, excluding bool; None when not observed
needed: Distinguish zero/one/multiple without storing proposals or parsing

name: proposal_match
source: Externally settled P7 full proposal-guard result; PROPOSAL_OBSERVATION.md
owner: P7 guard observer/evaluator, when separately available
meaning: True for full guard pass; False for actual association/tool/arguments mismatch; None when not compared/observed
needed: Distinguish one matching/mismatching proposal without comparison inside producer

name: permission_outcome
trust: Observed policy outcome; record grants nothing
meaning: Actual ALLOW/REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION/DENY or None; sources must agree
needed: Permission-deny and confirmation-required evidence without claiming a confirmation

name: candidate_obligation
meaning: None for conversation/stop, including a stop with an obligation state
needed: Obligation distribution without deriving one after failure

name: candidate_source
meaning: None for stop; conversational MODEL_RAW is a label only; no raw text
needed: CT-001/013 source support without operational truth or rendering
